summary_en: This study tests lymphoscintigraphy-directed elective neck radiation with primary chemoradiation for p16-positive, favorable risk oropharynx cancer. Radiation therapy is given Monday to Friday in 35 fractions over 6 or 7 weeks, with cisplatin 40mg/m2 given weekly for 7 weeks. The record does not state the main outcome measure; it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radiación electiva del cuello guiada por linfocentellografía, junto con quimiorradioterapia primaria, para el cáncer de orofaringe p16 positivo de riesgo favorable. La radioterapia se administra de lunes a viernes en 35 fracciones durante 6 o 7 semanas, con cisplatino de 40 mg/m2 semanal durante 7 semanas. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide; es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Squamous cell cancer of the oropharynx confirmed by pathology
Tumor shows moderate to severe p16 staining in at least 70% of cells
Node-negative with tumor within 1 cm of midline, or N1 with more than one node on the cancer's side
Disease that can be measured under RECIST 1.1
ECOG performance status 0-1 and age 18 or older
not_for: Prior systemic therapy for this cancer, or prior head and neck surgery involving the neck
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or allergy to technetium-99m tilmanocept
